name: Install Claude Code
description: Anthropic's official installer in both flavours: a POSIX sh one-liner for macOS, Linux and WSL, and a PowerShell one for native Windows. Pick the one that matches the shell you are running in.
author: voltius

snippets.name: Install Claude Code (macOS/Linux/WSL)
snippets.description: POSIX sh. Installs to ~/.local/bin and self-updates in the background. Also the right one for a Git Bash or WSL shell on Windows.

steps.content:
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash

# The installer adds ~/.local/bin to PATH in your shell profile; this session
# may not have picked it up yet.
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
claude --version

snippets.name: Install Claude Code (Windows PowerShell)
snippets.description: PowerShell, for a local Windows shell. Not for cmd.exe, and not for a session on a Linux host — those want the macOS/Linux/WSL snippet.
